hours.value: Home visits by arrangement. Clinic Thursdays 14:00–20:00 at The Pain and Injury Clinic, Stratford-upon-Avon.

services.detail: Assessment and treatment in your own home across Coventry, Warwickshire and the West Midlands.
Assessment and treatment for dizziness and vertigo, including unsteadiness and positional symptoms.
Support for neck pain, including symptoms linked to trapped nerves.
Care for back pain, including sciatica, as part of musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
Hip, knee, ankle, foot and heel pain — new or longer-standing.
Shoulder, elbow, wrist, hand, thumb and shoulder-blade pain.
Support for longer-standing pain, with honest advice and a whole-person approach.
Physiotherapy support after more complex, multi-area injury.

copy.headline: Physiotherapy at home across Coventry.
copy.introduction: Evidence-based musculoskeletal physiotherapy in the comfort of your home across Coventry, Warwickshire and the West Midlands. Clinic sessions are also available in Stratford-upon-Avon on Thursdays.

reviews.name: NHS Patient
reviews.quote: With only a few sessions with Alex the progress was Amazing. I’ve been coming for physio for a while and losing faith, until Alex took me on.

reviews.name: Patient
reviews.quote: First class, very efficient and I was in and out. Alex is excellent, lovely guy I would recommend to anyone with an injury.

reviews.name: Patient
reviews.quote: Alex really helped with calming my muscles down and my overall fear with my back strains. I’m excited to see my improvement.

reviews.name: NHS Patient
reviews.quote: Alex the physio was prompt and polite also. In the session he was very knowledgeable and explained all the stages in a manner that I understood. When we discussed options again it was done very well and not pushy. Everything was explained to me.

reviews.name: Patient
reviews.quote: As before, there was hardly any waiting time. Alex was friendly and professional. He listened to me and incorporated my suggestions into the treatment plan.

visits.title: First appointment
includes: History taking and assessment — usually about half to three-quarters of the visit
Feedback on findings and a working diagnosis where appropriate
Starting treatment, often with exercises or lifestyle changes between sessions

visits.title: Follow-up appointment
includes: Review of progress since the last visit
Continued treatment for the problem being managed
Updates to exercises or lifestyle changes where helpful

people.name: Alex Whyte
people.detail: Alex is the physiotherapist behind Whyte Physio. He offers specialist musculoskeletal physiotherapy at home, with experience in injury recovery, post-surgical rehabilitation and chronic pain. He also works in the NHS as a Clinical Specialist and Team Lead in MSK Outpatients. Published credentials include BSc (Hons) Physiotherapy, HCPC and MCSP.

people.name: Ellie
people.role: Behind the scenes · rehabilitation case manager
people.detail: Ellie is introduced on the Whyte Physio About page as the person behind the scenes. She is a physiotherapist by background and works as a rehabilitation case manager, supporting people who need coordinated rehabilitation after injury. Whyte Physio grew from the difficulty of finding specialist home-based MSK physiotherapy.
